question: Click the Exhibit. The router with the configuration shown in the exhibit has two interfaces, both of which are operational and can pass traffic. The amount of time to detect a link or node failure C. The amount of time required to recalculate the best detour D. The amount of time it takes to ping the gateway on the detour link
